Strong knowledge of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPNs, routing & switching Hands-on experience with firewalls (Cisco, Palo Alto, Fortinet, etc.) and security monitoring tools Ability to work collaboratively in cross-functional teams and independently Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field Industry certifications such as CCNA, CCNP, CISSP or equivalent are preferred
